reconcile.note: Gill reads Paul's 'ransom for all' as covering all sorts and classes of people rather than every individual, matching the 'many' in Matthew and Mark.

discrepancy.emptyNote: Steve Wells catalogues the many/all wording as a direct contradiction over the scope of Christ's atonement.

sides.snippet: to give his life as a ransom for many.
sides.verseText: even as the Son of Man came not to be served, but to serve, and to give his life as a ransom for many.\"
